_note: Inputs for scripts/burst_calc.py. Every value needs a source; null = not yet sourced (the material is skipped, never guessed). Values marked 'pending: chemistry lead' are being sourced by the Fable chemistry-lead review. SI units.

density_kg_m3.source: NIST X-ray mass attenuation coefficients, Table 1 (aluminium, 2.699 g/cm3); via chemistry-lead memo 2026-10-31 [S18]

conductivity_W_mK.source: NIST cryogenic materials property page, 6061-T6 aluminium at 300 K (reviewer's evaluation of NIST's fit); via chemistry-lead memo [S19]. Not used by the model (fin efficiency taken as 1).

latent_heat_J_per_kg.source: Mondieig et al., Chem. Mater. 16, 786 (2004), doi:10.1021/cm031169p (via tier1.json)

density_solid_kg_m3.source: Shlosinger & Bentilla 1965, as compiled in Hirschey et al. 2018 (via tier1.json)

density_liquid_kg_m3.source: CRC Handbook 95th ed. p. 3-424 via PubChem/HSDB, 0.7768 g/cm3 at 28 C (pitch claims register S17; secondary; phase at Tm not stated)

conductivity_liquid_W_mK.source: Velez et al., Appl. Energy 143, 383 (2015), doi:10.1016/j.apenergy.2015.01.054, Fig. 6b inset, liquid n-octadecane 303-318 K (read from the figure, +/-2%); via chemistry-lead memo [S17]

density_solid_kg_m3.source: The Merck Index (1996) via PubChem/HSDB, 5.9037 g/cm3 at 29.65 C (pitch S18; secondary)

density_liquid_kg_m3.source: Assael et al., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 41, 033101 (2012), doi:10.1063/1.4729873, at Tm (via tier1.json)

conductivity_liquid_W_mK.source: Ho, Powell, Liley, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 1, 279 (1972), doi:10.1063/1.3253100, liquid at 302.93 K (via tier1.json; OCR of a scan)

melting_point_K.source: Zamora, Martinez-Pastor, Faura, Materials 14, 7392 (2021), doi:10.3390/ma14237392, Table 3

density_solid_kg_m3.note: pending: chemistry lead (tier1.json: not found; Zamora's 7880 kg/m3 is an unsourced input)
